article.story:
Punjab Kings 210 for 5 (Shreyas 50, Prabhsimran 43, Arya 39, Kamboj 2-43, Henry 2-54) beat Chennai Super Kings 209 for 5 (Mhatre 73, Dube 45, Vyshak 2-38) by five wickets

Punjab are the Kings of 200-plus chases in the IPL. They'd done it eight times before Friday night, and they did it again as Priyansh Arya and Shreyas Iyer laid waste to the Chennai Super Kings bowling attack. Arya had 33 off 9 when the PBKS fifty came up in the fourth over of their innings. Shreyas was 4 off 5 before accelerating to a 26-ball fifty.

CSK are now winless after two games and what will worry them is that they were outplayed in conditions that enhance their strength. They have a strong top five. Pitches like this one, which allow them to hit through the line, makes them stronger. But the 209 for 5 they put up didn't cover for the weakness in their bowling.

PBKS' win was their fourth in a row against CSK at the MA Chidambaram Stadium.

Mhatre on song

An 18-year-old who came into a struggling team mid-season last year and emerged as one of their best players might have had reason to believe he had established himself. But with the arrival of Sanju Samson, Ayush Mhatre was bumped down from opener to No. 3. Samson hasn't been able to get going, falling for two single-digit scores, but the knock-on effect that had on Friday was that Mhatre was out there in the powerplay. And with the field up, he had the liberty to play his shots, and some of them were just so good, including a forehand smash across the line against Vyshak Vijaykumar.

Mhatre was dismissed on the pull shot in the first game of CSK's season. In the lead-up to this one, Mike Hussey with the whanger kept feeding him short balls and he kept working on the swivel-pull. That work paid off. The third boundary he hit - of three back-to-back - was a confident swivel-pull - and Mhatre deserves more credit for it because the first two were full balls that he had put away over mid-on to engineer that change in length from Xavier Bartlett.

Later, when the field spread and the PBKS bowlers were having success keeping others quiet with wide yorkers - Shivam Dube was 14 off 14 at one point - Mhatre dug one out for a single. That was 10.2. By 10.5, he'd found a solution for a ball the bowler thought was a banker - bringing the bat down as he had done before but this time opening the face to beat short third and backward point to their right and deep point to the left. It was a shot that combined quick thinking with perfect timing.

Mhatre was dropped on 59 and 67 and eventually fell for 73 off 43. At the time, the other end had contributed 38 off 32. The extras chipped in with 12.

Sarfaraz supreme

Mhatre fell during a period where PBKS picked up three wickets for 20 runs in three overs. In that time, CSK's projected score slipped from 200 to 185.

CSK's middle order is a problem with Dewald Brevis recovering from a side injury. But it didn't feel like a problem while Sarfaraz Khan was at the crease. As a domestic stalwart, he has seen it all and done it all. As one of the IPL's first teenage stars, when he was sharing a dressing room with Virat Kohli and Chris Gayle, he has always got T20 cricket. Some of his shots were so cool. There was one where it seemed like he'd left a bouncer, the ball going past him before he pushed his bat up at it and sent it for six over the keeper. There were several that he nonchalantly deflected to the deep third boundary and these were off deliveries that the bowler thought he had done well, either going yorker or going into the wicket without giving any room. Sarfaraz's 32 off 12 balls carried CSK to 209 for 5. It was the first 200-plus score at Chepauk in the IPL since April 2024.

Arya rises

This was a day for breathtaking cameos. Arya topped Sarfaraz's efforts with 39 off 11 balls. PBKS assistant coach Brad Haddin recalled how Arya had wowed the whole coaching staff when he started batting in the camp ahead of IPL 2025. The bat speed in particular was unbelievable. But what really impressed Haddin was that when Arya joined the team ahead of this season, he had improved on his strengths. He had downed CSK with a century last year. He needed just 11 balls to down them this year. The shots were pure too. There was an on-the-up cover drive for four with zero follow-through that told CSK what they were giving him just wasn't good enough. PBKS brought up their fifty in the fourth over. They downed more than 30% of the target inside the powerplay.

Shreyas smash

CSK's bowlers created a little bit of pressure between the ninth and 12th overs when they were gifted Prabhsimran Singh's wicket through a run-out and Cooper Connolly's off a full-toss. At the start of the 13th over, PBKS' chances of victory, according to the ESPNcricinfo forecaster, was 45%. CSK brought on Rahul Chahar to see if they could push their advantage. Shreyas whacked him for two sixes, moved from 4 off 5 to 19 off 10. PBKS' chances of winning after those six balls was up at 65%. It didn't take long for that figure to hit 100. Shreyas helped himself to a 26-ball fifty.

Gaikwad perishes trying to attack! On a length and sliding down leg. Gaikwad brings out the sweep but cannot quite free his arms as much as he would have wanted. Hits it well but straight to Wadhera at deep backward square leg. Gaikwad throws his head back in disappointment, and it is that man Chahal with the breakthrough again!

goneski! Straight to short third, and Mhatre departs! Very full and very wide again. Mhatre jams down on it, while opening his bat face. Gets under this one, though, and the ball flies through to Chahal. Mhatre is livid with himself; Vyshak, absolutely delighted. PBKS with two wickets in quick succession!

big lbw appeal, and Jansen wants the review. And he gets the review too! Speared in full on middle stump. Kartik gets down low and swipes across the line. Gets rapped in front and this could spell trouble for him. Was it doing too much, though, especially with the angle from around the wicket? Flat line on UltraEdge. Ball Tracking comes up and...it shows the ball to be thundering into the inside of leg stump. Kartik has to go, and PBKS keep chipping away!

and the change in plan works! Hard length just outside off. Sarfaraz, aware of the field change, tries to muscle it down the ground. Cannot get the purchase he wants, though, and only musters the height he desires. Wadhera back-pedals from mid on and snares the chance. An enterprising cameo, but CSK will now need someone else to take them to 200!

off stump flat on the ground! Henry roars, and Chepauk roars in unison! Hard length on middle and leg, and this seems to nip away a shade. Arya hares down and swipes at it without a care in the world. Misses the ball completely and sees his off stump in a mess. An 11-ball 39 for Arya, but CSK finally have the wicket they were craving!

details.shortText: Noor Ahmad to Prabhsimran Singh, 1 run, OUT
details.text: oh dear - that is a terrible mix-up and CSK have a wicket out of nothing! Back of a length on off. Prabhsimran dinks it into the mid wicket region. Prabhsimran wants two and sets off, even with Noor chasing after it. In the end, Noor fumbles and that allows Sarfaraz to walk onto the ball and hurl a throw at the bowler's end. Prabhsimran, in the meantime, has run half-way down the track, only to be sent back. Nowhere in the frame, and PBKS have lost both their openers!

holes out to long off, and the crowd comes alive again! Full toss just outside off. Connolly tries to smash it down the ground but the bat face opens upon contact. A bit of a slice in the end and Connolly could not have picked out Henry better. CSK still in this!

straight to the sweeper, and Kamboj has another! Is it too little, too late, though? Full and wide outside off. Shreyas reaches out and gets a good chunk of it too. Not a good enough chunk to clear the fence, however, and Chahar accepts the offering with glee at sweeper cover!

oh, hello! Oh, hello! This game may not be done just yet! Hung up full and wide. Wadhera skips down and throws his hands at it. Cannot control his waft, though, and he slices it straight to Noor at extra cover. Chepauk erupts, and CSK may just have a sniff here!

218050.text: that will do it! A thundering blow to wrap up a commanding run-chase! Kamboj misses the yorker on the shorter side. On off and Stoinis blasts it over the bowler's head. Muted celebrations from those in the PBKS camp. This was another stellar run-chase and the best part about it, from a PBKS perspective, was that it never really seemed in doubt!
218050.postText: 11:48pm That will be all from us for tonight. We will be back with more IPL action tomorrow. In fact, we have a double-header lined up. Until then, though, from Ranjith and myself (Shashwat), it is goodbye! Priyansh Arya, Player of the Match: (On his aggressive batting style) I am a little like this from when I was young, and because it benefits the team, I play in this fashion. There is a risk but I have belief in myself that I can hit the first ball. (Step-up from state leagues to the IPL) There is a bit of difference because the bowlers are experienced, and it helps to have belief in myself. I do two sessions of batting each day, and those sessions are for 1-1.5 hours each. I love batting. My family background is of teachers, and my sister is also a teacher. Sometimes I think I could have been a teacher too. (On if he will become a teacher now) Absolutely no chance now (smiles). Shreyas Iyer, PBKS captain: The way we started today, that was an exceptional start for us. I feel the way they (Arya and Prabhsimran) have been batting has been phenomenal and it stabilizes the rhythm for us. I am glad everyone is getting to bat. It gives immense confidence to the team. Whenever we are in a pressure situation, people are aware on how to handle it. We just decided in the dressing room, we will play a brand of cricket to impress each other - that gives us a certain sort of clarity, and basically challenging each other. Getting 39 off 11 balls, that is the start we require. (On his message to the bowlers) It was a belter to bat on but the way we started, 25 off three overs…it is important we remain calm. Over-rate is something we should look at (moving forward) and it is the only part we should focus on. (On not bowling out Chahal) Decided to go with the seamers (seeing the batters they had). We all know how impressive he (Chahal) is, and whenever in doubt, I go to him. Ruturaj Gaikwad, CSK captain: I feel it was a really good score. Wicket was better for pacers but it was gripping - slower balls were gripping too. With big boundaries, felt it was a really good score. (On the Impact Player) We felt we had three seamers and having two wrist-spinners bowling in tandem will help. Off-day for both of them and that is what cost us. (On the bowling in general) Mixture of both - sometimes, we executed well, sometimes, we did not execute well. The pressure did not build. There was a point when it (required run-rate) went to 11, and a couple of good overs would have taken it to 12-13. We just did not get momentum in the middle (with the ball). Tough one (to take). Lot of positives. Ayush batted brilliantly. Shivam batted really well. Batting wise, we had good confidence. Bowling wise, lot to improve. (On his innings) Today, I felt to stick around a bit. Wicket was gripping, so thought to hang in there and then cash in but unfortunately, got out at the wrong time. Cooper Connolly: (On the Orange Cap) Still pretty early in the season, trying to put my best foot forward. Stoked to win two (to start) but still 12 games to go. (On his role) To capitalize on the back end of the powerplay, stick to how I play the game and go from there. (On adapting to the IPL and if it has been difficult) Not particularly. Helps with a few Aussie boys around. Have played some cricket (here) with Australia A. Still a long time to go, and looking forward to picking their brains. Hopefully I will have the ball in my hand very soon. Unfortunate that I have not been able to bowl, but looking forward to getting back on the park and bowling. 11:24pm A marathon game, in terms of how long it lasted, but the result seemed like a foregone conclusion for much of the chase. Arya teed off in the powerplay, rattling along to 39 off 11 and that set the tone for the rest of the innings. Shreyas then ensured there were no hiccups (like against DC), with the others, including Connolly, also chipping in nicely. CSK, on the other hand, lacked the necessary incision. They could not penetrate through their spinners and the tap they took in the powerplay was too severe to come back from. They also used only five bowlers, despite having Dube and Veer in their ranks, and they now have several questions to answer, heading into their next game, which is on Sunday and away to the defending champions.

218040.text: zipped in full on the pads. Shashank whips it towards deep backward square leg

218030.preText: Pritej: "Why not have deep third so many boundaries have gone" -- CSK hedged their bets. And lost.
218030.text: short and sliding a shade down leg. Shashank gets inside the line and misses his swipe. Called a wide and CSK, after a bit of thought, have reviewed. They might have a case here. Third umpire says the batter was in his normal stance. No bat involved either, meaning the wide call remains!

218020.text: full ball on the pads. Shashank works it into the deep square leg region and canters back for two

218010.preText: 12 off 12. Run-a-ball needed. PBKS would ideally not want to take it to the 20th. Kamboj to bowl the 19th
218010.text: that is a stunning shot! Low full toss wide outside off. Shashank opens his bat face and scorches it through backward point!

217060.text: low full toss outside off. Shashank drives it to sweeper cover and keeps strike

217050.text: more runs over short third! Full outside off. Shashank swishes at it with pure abandon and musters a thick outside edge that clears the fielder in the ring!

217040.text: in the air but safe! Slot ball laced with width. Shashank takes a step across and chips it over extra cover. Back for a brace

217030.text: full toss outside off. Stoinis taken aback a touch and he scuffs it back to the bowler, who leaps to his left and parries it to long off

217020.preText: Stoinis in at 7. Neither batter has faced a ball yet. Around the wicket
217020.text: first-ball boundary for Stoinis! Full and hidden a mile outside off. Stoinis chases after it and gets a thick enough outside edge to beat short third to his right!

217010.preText: 24 off 18. Shashank the new batter. Wadhera on strike for now. Henry to bowl

216060.text: hard length, slanted across the batter just outside off. Shreyas tries to smash it into the Bay of Bengal, but does not make any contact

216050.text: how has that missed?! Kamboj spears in a leg-stump yorker and it nearly catches Shreyas off-guard. The batter had moved across and then missed his flick. An extra coat of paint and leg stump may have been pegged back. But all of that might have been immaterial because Kamboj has overstepped...

216040.text: finds the fence this time, and Shreyas brings up another half-century as PBKS skipper! Full and wide again. Shreyas throws the plumbing at it and slices it over short third. A 26-ball fifty for the captain!

216030.text: did that carry?! Another wide yorker. Shreyas jams down on it and squeezes it out towards short third. Not sure if that carried, or if it was a bump ball. Not a bump ball, and it may just have carried to Henry!

216020.preText: Guru: "I can already sense another disappointing season for Chennai Super Kings. No other team looks as vulnerable as CSK right now."
216020.text: full and wide outside off. Shreyas tries to reach out for it and fails to do so. He reckons it is wide enough to be an extra, and he reviews. Could be touch-and-go. Shreyas did not move across his stumps as such, meaning the tramlines would not have shifted a lot. Replays, though, suggest Shreyas did take a step across. The ball is well inside the revised guideline and the original call stays!

216010.preText: Time for another pause. PBKS running away with this game, and CSK will need something very special from here to get anything out of this contest. Kamboj to bowl. CSK need this to be a two-wicket over. Around the wicket
216010.text: slot ball and punished! On middle and leg, and Shreyas clears his front leg to batter it to deep mid wicket's left!
